mechanism: Every time a page finishes loading, onSaveHistory -> RdbUtils.insertDate re-queries the date_table for the current date and re-runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for the per-day history table, even though the same date is looked up on every save within a session. The redundant query + DDL run on each page navigation and add avoidable RDB round-trips to the page-save path.
fix_summary: Cache already-verified per-day tables in an in-memory Set (RdbUtils.knownDates); insertDate returns early on cache hit, and deleteAll clears the cache.

performance_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
